note: Per-hull, speed-keyed High-Energy Turn (HET) integer table for Community Edition 2.670. All sim table entries (speed, delayTicks, turnAngle16, turnRate16PerTick) are integers with no floats. Angles are 16-bit angle units (65536 = full turn) as signed i32, NOT Q16.16. Durations are integer ticks at 30 Hz.
delayNote: Measured (CE in-battle capture 2026-11-24): ~5.7 s at 30 Hz = 171 integer ticks before HET rotation starts (replaces earlier 162-tick estimate).
speedCutoffNote: No speed cutoff: CE in-battle capture 2026-11-24 confirmed HET works at speeds 15, 20, and 31. The earlier 'no HET at speed 15+' observation was wrong.

interpolation.note: Between adjacent integer speed points (s0 < s < s1), linearly interpolate in fixed-point integer math (no floats) using rulesDiv with symmetric nearest-integer rounding; clamp speeds below the first point or above the last point to the nearest endpoint.

rounding.workedExample: 8 deg/s = 48.545... -> 49 integer angle units per tick at 30 Hz

energyCostNote: Placeholder: HET energy cost and breakdown roll are TO VERIFY.
hullOrderNote: Stable sim ids: engine/sim numbers hull rows by their position in this list, so append new hull keys at the end. Every key under hulls must be listed. default is the row for hulls with no entry of their own. Editing a row's speedPoints needs no code change.
